facts.claim: The Florence store is at 5885 Merchants, Florence, KY 41042; call 859-372-0240 to discuss collection or assistance.
facts.quote: Florence Directions Your Store 5885 Merchants Florence, KY 41042 859-372-0240

facts.claim: The Florence page offers curbside pickup: order online, drive up, and staff will help load the order into the car. It does not specify a weight limit, trunk-only loading or transfer assistance.
facts.quote: Curbside Pickup Order online, drive up, and we’ll help load it into your car.

facts.claim: The branch also offers in-store pickup and same-day delivery through an Instacart shopper. Confirm delivery coverage and assistance for the actual address; the listing does not promise indoor carrying.
quote: In-Store Pickup Order online and we’ll have it ready for you in the store.
Same Day Delivery Have an Instacart shopper bring your order to you.

facts.claim: The published pickup terms, last updated March 20, 2020, describe a one-hour collection window. At curbside stores, park in the designated pickup area and call the supplied store number; show the order confirmation. Confirm the instructions supplied for the actual order.
quote: When you place your order, you will be prompted to select a one-hour pickup window. Your order will be picked and ready by the pickup window selected. For stores offering Curbside Pickup, park in the designated Pickup Area and contact the store using the phone number provided.
For either pickup method, you will be asked to show a copy of your order confirmation .

facts.claim: For people who are not Gordon GO members, the in-store pickup page describes ordering additional warehouse products through the Customer Service Desk. An associate can help find the product, order it and schedule collection; the store calls when it is ready. This requires an in-store visit, not a verified phone-order service.
quote: Not a Member? Stop by our Customer Service Desk and ask to browse the catalog of thousands of additional restaurant quality products for delivery to the store. Our Store Associate can help you find the product you’re looking for, order it and schedule a pickup date that works for you. When your order is ready to be picked up, the store will call you and let you know.

facts.claim: The in-store pickup FAQ allows someone else to collect the order. If paying on account, that person must present their membership card. Confirm the collection method and identification for the order being placed.
facts.quote: Can I have someone else pick up my order? Yes. However, if paying on account, the person must present their membership card.

facts.claim: The in-store pickup FAQ says orders are usually held for 24 hours after the scheduled collection date if safe to do so. Orders containing fresh items are available only on the selected date; arrange collection accordingly.
facts.quote: We will usually hold your order for 24 hours past your scheduled pickup date, assuming it is safe to do so. Please Note: orders containing fresh items will only be available for pickup on your selected pickup date.
